title: pandiaka angustifolia
intro: Pandiaka angustifolia, commonly known as the Narrow-leaved Pandiaka, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Pandiaka angustifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various infections and diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Pandiaka angustifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
